mentions.name: Hidden Signal
mentions.description: This platform collects a user's newsletters and returns them as summarized digests delivered daily (or multiple times a day), helping people actually read their newsletters instead of letting them pile up unread in the inbox.
mentions.problem: Newsletters get ignored and pile up unread in people's inboxes.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a newsletter digest platform to collect your newsletters and give them back to you, summarized, in a daily (or multiple times a day) digest.

evidence.value: I'm working on a newsletter digest platform to collect your newsletters and give them back to you, summarized, in a daily (or multiple times a day) digest.
